newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end lower with investors sidelined.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end lower with investors sidelined.

text.p: Tokyo stocks drifted in negative territory for most of Thursday's session and ended slightly lower.
Qualms about Japan's economic recovery and the aftereffects of brokerage scandals kept most investors from buying stocks actively, brokers said.
The Nikkei 225 average closed down 75.01 points or 0.37 percent at 20,121.41. Its September futures fell 50 to 20.170.

"There were no specific factors to stimulate trading and people were completely in a wait-and-see mood. Overseas players seemed to have held back from buying after the end-June book closings (by foreign firms)," said a trader at a foreign securities house.
